name: SKF Explorer Deep Groove Radial Ball Bearing (Sealed 2RS / Shielded 2Z)
shortDescription: Premium SKF Explorer series deep groove radial ball bearing featuring ultra-clean steel, honed raceways, and contact rubber seals (2RS1) for high-speed industrial machinery.
overview: SKF is the undisputed global benchmark in bearing technology, and the SKF Explorer deep groove radial ball bearing represents decades of tribological leadership. Manufactured from exceptionally clean, vacuum-degassed high-carbon chromium steel, it features optimized internal micro-geometry with super-finished raceways that drastically reduce friction, running noise, and operating temperature. Fitted with dual nitrile butadiene rubber (NBR) contact seals (2RS1) and pre-lubricated with high-grade synthetic polyurea grease, it provides lifetime maintenance-free operation and impervious sealing against dust, grit, and moisture.
keyFeatures: SKF Explorer class engineering delivering up to 300% longer service life than standard bearings
Ultra-clean 100Cr6 bearing steel minimizes subsurface fatigue and micro-spalling
Super-finished, honed raceways generate significantly lower frictional torque and running noise
Dual contact NBR lip seals (2RS1) lock in grease and permanently block dust and water ingress
High dynamic and static load ratings capable of carrying radial and moderate axial loads
Pre-filled with premium SKF high-temperature wide-range grease for life-long lubrication
ISO Normal / P6 precision running accuracy suitable for high-speed electric motor shafts

specifications.Bearing Type: Single Row Deep Groove Radial Ball Bearing
specifications.Sealing Type: Dual Contact Rubber Seals (2RS1) or Metal Shields (2Z)

applications: Industrial electric motors, blowers, and centrifugal ventilation fans
High-speed machine tool spindles, gearboxes, and power transmissions
Conveyor roller idlers, material handling pulleys, and agricultural harvesters
Centrifugal water pumps, compressors, and automotive alternators
